name: Rau Cliffrunner
summary: At Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner keeps watch over Thousand Needles and studies the Galak centaur. He works with allies in Thunder Bluff to guard his people from threats across the canyon.

sections.title: Watcher of the Canyons
sections.body: From Freewind Post, Rau Cliffrunner watches the broad reaches of Thousand Needles. Predators, quilboar, and hostile centaur clans surround the tauren outpost. Rau helps organize the post and investigates dangers before they can threaten the mesa settlements.

sections.title: Secrets of the Galak
sections.body:
Rau Cliffrunner studies the centaur, who have fought the tauren for generations. The Galak guard a sacred relic tied to their beginnings, and Rau seeks a way past its mystical protections.

With Zangen Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff, Rau obtains sacred moonwell water from Ashenvale. It can extinguish the eternal flame at Splithoof Hold and clear the way to retrieve the Cloven Hoof for his study.

faq.q: Where can I find Rau Cliffrunner?
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner is atop Freewind Post, a mesa outpost in the middle of Thousand Needles.

aliases: why does rau want the hoof
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner studies the centaur's origins and mystical traditions. He seeks the Cloven Hoof, an ancient Galak relic kept within Splithoof Crag, whose strange energies may shed light on the tauren's historic enemies.

faq.q: Why does Rau need moonwell water?
faq.answer: Rau Cliffrunner needs moonwell water to extinguish the eternal mystical fire guarding the Galak relic. Pure water from a night elven moonwell in Ashenvale carries sacred power to quench the brazier's flame and breach its ward.

faq.q: Who is working with Rau Cliffrunner in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Zangen Stonehoof works with Rau Cliffrunner from the High Rise of Thunder Bluff. Zangen arranges to retrieve moonwell water from Ashenvale, then directs trusted Horde travelers to Rau at Freewind Post.
The Cloven Hoof is an ancient centaur artifact kept by the Galak clan in Splithoof Hold. It dates to the creation of the centaur race and radiates unusual energy Rau hopes to decipher.

faq.q: Does Rau Cliffrunner belong to a specific tauren tribe?
faq.answer: No specific tribe is recorded for Rau Cliffrunner. He is a tauren warrior of Thunder Bluff stationed at Freewind Post, and his surname is not tied to a named tribe.

angles.text: For the tauren, understanding the centaur is a matter of cultural survival. Rau Cliffrunner studies their beginnings for insight into the ancestral conflict that nearly drove the Shu'halo to extinction.
Rau Cliffrunner's work helps secure Freewind Post, an isolated Horde stronghold that supports supply lines between the Barrens and Tanaris.
